items.description: Pinned split-screen storytelling layout where scrolling through text chapters on the left animates the sticky media stage on the right in real time.

items.name: story-cards
items.title: Story Cards
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Interactive looped story card showcase featuring continuous virtual looping, spring-animated expanding active slides, mouse-wheel scrub, touch gestures, and keyboard navigation.

items.name: terminal-window-mockup
items.title: Terminal Window Mockup
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: macOS dark terminal window frame featuring traffic light buttons, prompt symbols (❯), a blinking cursor, command output lines, and a one-click copy command button.

items.name: thunderstorm
items.title: Thunderstorm
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Dramatic thunderstorm background featuring recursive midpoint-displacement branching lightning bolts, dark rolling cloud banks, and wind-driven rain streaks on Canvas 2D.

items.name: tilt-credit-card3-d
items.title: Tilt Credit Card 3D
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Revolut and Apple Card-inspired premium 3D metal card with cursor-tilt gyroscope physics, rainbow holographic foil reflection, gold EMV chip, contactless RFID waves, and dual-side flip mechanics.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Stacked viewport notification toasts supporting 6 viewport positions (top/bottom + left/center/right), hover fan-out, and auto-dismiss.

items.name: transaction-receipt
items.title: Transaction Receipt
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Perforated fintech digital receipt card inspired by Monzo and Stripe with an authentic zigzag bottom tear edge, itemized breakdown, barcode, and animated spring rubber stamps (PAID, SETTLED, REFUNDED).

items.name: typewriter-cursor-effect
items.title: Typewriter Cursor Effect
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Rotating multi-phrase typewriter effect with humanized typing rhythms, backspace cadence, and an animated blinking beam cursor.

items.name: underwater-caustics
items.title: Underwater Caustics
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Shimmering underwater caustic light network powered by a real-time WebGL fragment shader with subtle chromatic dispersion, diagonal volumetric God-ray sunbeams, and buoyant rising bubbles.

items.name: variable-proximity-text
items.title: Variable Proximity Text
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Interactive kinetic typography where each glyph interpolates vertical lift, scale, and contrast based on real-time 2D cursor proximity.

items.name: warp-speed
items.title: Warp Speed
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: 3D hyperspace starfield using perspective projection (`screenX = x / z`, `screenY = y / z`), delta-time streak rendering, a cursor-following vanishing point, and a warp jump accelerator.

items.name: water-ripples
items.title: Water Ripples
items.author: Rishabh Bose <https://theb0se.vercel.app/>
items.description: Interactive water surface ripple simulation combining a real-time 2D finite-difference wave-equation height-map buffer with expanding specular caustic refraction rings triggered by cursor wakes, clicks, and ambient droplets.
